chapter.num: Hangout Event: Yun Jin - Act I
chapter.title: A Song That Knows Grace

dialogues.speaker: Clerk Zhao
dialogues.text: Just wonderful... Oh, no! I'm late for my meeting!

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Hmm? What're you up to? Did you just arrive after the show was over?

dialogues.speaker: Guan Hong
dialogues.text: Haha. Sorry, friend, but if you missed Yun Jin's show, you're gonna regret it for the rest of your life!

dialogues.speaker: Changhu
dialogues.text: How very strange. I don't usually feel anything when listening to Liu Su's stories. But once Yun Jin started singing, I was completely spellbound...

dialogues.speaker: Changhu
dialogues.text: Wait... Master? Master! Where have you gone, Master?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Voice of an angel, delicate as a murmuring stream...

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: The moment Yun Jin got on the stage, it took me right back... Oh, the resemblance was... *sigh*... What a captivating performance.
